events.description: Carter-Thatcher telephone call on Soviet intervention in Afghanistan and Iran hostage UN resolution.
Soviet intervention in Afghanistan, described as turning a buffer state into a puppet nation.
Proposed North Atlantic Council meeting in London over the weekend on Afghanistan, with Warren Christopher attending.
Carter planned a personal public statement that afternoon on the Soviet intervention.
Vance to deliver US message on Iran to the UN Security Council tomorrow or the next day.
Carter-Thatcher phone call on Soviet intervention in Afghanistan and Iran resolution.
Proposed North Atlantic Council meeting on Afghanistan over the weekend with a high-level US representative.
Vance and Genscher conversation that morning on German concerns.
Vance to deliver US Iranian message to the UN Security Council.
National Security Council meeting decided a two-step approach on Iran sanctions.

relationships.detail: Telephone conversation on Afghanistan and Iran.
relationships.quote: the President told Mrs. Thatcher that he wanted to speak to her about Afghanistan

relationships.detail: Described as the top man second only to Vance.
relationships.quote: Warren Christopher, our top man second only to Cy Vance

relationships.detail: Soviet intervention turned Afghanistan into a puppet nation.
relationships.quote: Moscow had changed a buffer nation into a puppet nation under Soviet direction

relationships.detail: Vance to call Carrington to discuss details of the Christopher visit and Iran amendments.
relationships.quote: Cy Vance would call Lord Carrington in the next few hours

relationships.detail: Conversation that morning reflecting German concern.
relationships.quote: a conversation between Cy Vance and Genscher that morning

relationships.detail: Carter compared the Afghanistan intervention to the earlier Soviet action in Czechoslovakia.
relationships.quote: similar in scope and permanent impact to what the Soviets did in Czechoslovakia.

relationships.detail: Carter intended to call on Nonaligned countries to speak out against the Soviet intervention.
relationships.quote: The President said he intended to call on these countries to speak out against the Soviet intervention.

relationships.detail: Carter suggested Britain, China or Nonaligned states could take the UN initiative on Afghanistan in New York.
relationships.quote: There were others who could do this -- Britain, China or some of the Nonaligned countries.

relationships.detail: Carter wanted a North Atlantic Council meeting solely on Afghanistan.
relationships.quote: We would like to have a meeting of the North Atlantic Council solely on the Afghanistan problem.

relationships.detail: Thatcher said she and Carrington would be in London over the weekend to welcome a US representative.
relationships.quote: she and Peter Carrington would be about this weekend and a US representative would be very welcome in London.

relationships.detail: Carrington would be in London over the weekend.
relationships.quote: a US representative would be very welcome in London.

relationships.detail: The FRG worried about the precedent for relations between Warsaw Pact countries and European Allies.
relationships.quote: the precedent it established with relations between the Warsaw Pact countries and the European Allies.

relationships.detail: Christopher is described as second only to Vance.
relationships.quote: Warren Christopher, our top man second only to Cy Vance.

relationships.quote: he would probably send Warren Christopher

relationships.quote: Khomeini had no such desire although he was probably getting pressure from other members of the Revolutionary Council.

relationships.quote: he would be sending a strong personal message to Brezhnev

key_claims: Carter regarded the Soviet intervention in Afghanistan as an extremely grave development similar to Czechoslovakia.
Carter wanted to make the intervention politically costly, especially with Muslim and Nonaligned countries.
The US would not force the Soviets out of Afghanistan but would not let SALT concerns blunt condemnation.
Carter preferred that Britain, China or Nonaligned states raise Afghanistan at the UN because of US hostage efforts there.
Carter proposed a North Atlantic Council meeting with Warren Christopher attending.
West Germany feared the effects on Pakistan, Romania and Yugoslavia.
Carter planned a strong personal message to Brezhnev and urged Thatcher to do likewise.
